Baseline: 105 Studio modules identical to installed CP28/Momentum2/Maker8/Whale1; news off
Selection: Continue unchanged development gates. Separate validation seeds/worlds remain ungenerated until a single frozen candidate passes development and chart review. Do not reuse validation after a failure.
CurrentBX: Long-leg occupancy must fall, maximum leg must not rise, meaningful counter count must rise.
MeaningfulCounter: Close retracement >= max(6 ticks, 0.025% of extreme price, 20% of preceding leg). Dojis and smaller flickers never reset.
Target: 30-minute range 0.7-1.5% soft; report coverage and declines, never optimize candle colors
Safety: Matching/accounting/margin/stops/funding unchanged; exact replay each run. Before any installation: native suite/parity, no-recovery endurance, explicit version migration tests.

AdditionalGates.StrictPullbacks: At least one more completed strict pullback than baseline in total

Ablations: reserve-delay removes same-decision replacement; reserve-rest retains quotes until existing expiry; maker-rest retains normal quotes except existing adverse stale-risk cancellation; maker-no-skew removes only inventory reservation-price skew, retaining quantity feedback. Each arm changes one mechanism.
